requiredDateScopedCoverage.userAnswer: 처음에는 갱신하는 날짜에 등원하는 학생들에 대한 관련한 모든 정보(예습부터 숙제현황 교사가 적은 내용 등등 전부 흐름을 연결시켜주어야하고, UI/UX 시각화 디자인 등등 Main Sheet를 모두 개선해줘야함.
requiredDateScopedCoverage.roster: Every verified student attending the selected refresh lesson date, including all relevant groups and pages; do not infer membership from a Sheet name or row position.
flow: Verified lesson date, attending roster, student, course and lesson occurrence
Assigned homework range and matching pre-study upload/evidence
Problem attempts and authoritative backend grading
Wrong-answer video/correction status and the teacher's visual review
Official progress, homework and lesson record
Teacher notes, prior decisions and append-only corrections/drafts connected to the verified student and occurrence
requiredDateScopedCoverage.presentation: Date-first whole-class preparation in the single 박경찬 Main review surface, followed by selected-student evidence; each source keeps timestamps and provenance, and unknown/incomplete joins remain visible.
requiredDateScopedCoverage.emptyOrAbsentEvidence: An empty/unverified roster or absent source is unknown coverage, not a successful zero-student refresh or a completed preparation state. Missing app submissions do not prove non-completion.
requiredDateScopedCoverage.implementationBoundary: The current pure helper prepares one explicitly bound deployed row. It neither obtains a roster nor proves all-student/full-source coverage, performs a UI redesign, or installs a scheduler. Full-flow orchestration and field-to-template contracts remain to be verified.

nextRealFlow.action: Establish a current authenticated supported read path and prove one explicitly scoped teacher/date/student occurrence first. Then obtain the selected date's complete verified attending roster and all related preparation sources, with independently corroborated teacher/occurrence bindings and coverage. A single-row pilot is not all-student acceptance.
nextRealFlow.acceptance: assessAcademyReadAcceptance returns accepted; unknown field evidence remains unknown
nextRealFlow.currentBlocker: Fresh browser navigation returned a session-error page; authenticated backend transport is not exposed, and no unattended session provider is verified. A visible cached page or a successful sign-in alone is insufficient.

nextRealFlow.action: Review the exact stable student/occurrence to C4:R47 row binding and source-field-to-template-column contract. Start only with source fields actually obtained. The common template has LCAD, course assessment, progress and date columns; lesson attendance/homework/memo must not be inserted under those unrelated headings.
nextRealFlow.acceptance: Explicit source/teacher/preserve cell ownership and semantic evidence refs; O/R stay teacher plans; no legacy writes

nextRealFlow.action: Call decideRefreshDispatch(manual), durably claim once, then prepareAcceptedDeployedRowRefresh with fresh exact row inventory. Show before/after, unknowns, source age and preserved manual values in a sidebar/dialog or user review surface.
nextRealFlow.acceptance: Non-executable review with complete C:R before-state and only changed source cells

nextRealFlow.action: Obtain exact destination/value/recovery batch approval. A trusted writer authenticates approval, writes and verifies the before-ledger in the approved teacher-only destination, then rechecks target structure/binding/complete row and uses the existing auditedRefresh flow. Update only changed source userEnteredValue cells as literal values. Read back the same row and persist an outcome.
nextRealFlow.acceptance: Approved source changes match same-target readback; teacher values, notes, plans and formats remain unchanged
nextRealFlow.limitations: No live writer, approval verifier or private audit store is implemented here. Google Sheets preflight is not a transaction/CAS guarantee against concurrent human edits. Uncertain outcomes require read-only reconciliation, never blind replay or rollback.

nextRealFlow.action: Only after the manual flow and a supported unattended source session are proven, add the chosen runtime trigger and persistent claim/outcome store. Call the identical source/read/review pipeline. Automatic production source-cell writes require the exact bounded standing scope to be approved; journal writes remain separately reviewed.
nextRealFlow.requestedTime: Monday–Friday, any time 13:15–14:00 Asia/Seoul inclusive; manual refresh any day on demand
nextRealFlow.hostCandidate: Existing bound Apps Script atHour(13).nearMinute(30).everyDays(1).inTimezone('Asia/Seoul') with an explicit Asia/Seoul weekday dispatch guard; the daily host tick is not permission to refresh weekends. Exact host/project/owner and installation remain unverified.
nextRealFlow.acceptance: Actual installed trigger owner/ID and observed first run; visible last successful refresh versus latest attempted/failed/late run
nextRealFlow.timingLimit: Requested delivery window is not guaranteed uptime. Same-date scheduled weekend ticks return not_due. Late same-day weekday preparation runs are labeled late. Missed dates are recorded as missed rather than replayed into a new day's lesson. Both scheduled trigger names deduplicate against prior claims. Schedule-only acknowledgement is not deployment.

nextRealFlow.action: Use buildLessonJournalReviewBundle to show all six business fields; keep source evidence and teacher drafts separate. Current attendance/progress/homework/memo/daily-test refer to the current occurrence. Previous-homework assessment refers to the separately verified previous occurrence. Select the fields to save and present exact target/before/after/recovery for explicit approval.
nextRealFlow.reviewGrouping: selected_fields by default; student_lesson or whole_lesson are optional presentation modes, not mandatory all-field save rules
nextRealFlow.acceptance: Verified field-specific wire, validation, secondary-effect and readback contracts; authenticated exact-diff approval; independent same-target readback for each actual record
nextRealFlow.currentBlocker: Four core write candidates remain non-executing; two assessment controls have inspected source shapes but no verified writer/readback. Editing live controls can autosave, so approval must precede the edit/radio selection.

runtimeChoice.firstCandidate: Reuse the existing bound Apps Script only after identifying its actual project, installed code and trigger creator. Source-configured SPT web-app URL is not a project identity or proof of current code.
runtimeChoice.appsScriptIdentity: A manual bound-script action runs as the user at the keyboard; an installable clock trigger runs as its creator. Neither automatically uses main-sheet-bot or the dot cloud browser session.
runtimeChoice.portability: The current reusable TypeScript code uses Bun/Node crypto/util and is not an Apps Script bundle. A small reviewed portable wrapper/port or an authenticated existing bridge is required. Do not paste it into Apps Script and claim deployment.
runtimeChoice.gcpAlternative: ganga-daechi-260927-p0723 / main-sheet-bot remains the selected existing GCP identity. Cloud Run plus Scheduler is a possible deliberate keyless runtime choice, not the default. Both projects currently have billing disabled; no billing, API enablement, IAM expansion or service deployment is authorized by this plan.
runtimeChoice.privateLedger: Choose and approve an exact teacher-only durable audit destination before student values are copied there. Hidden tabs, shared workbook properties and private-looking titles do not prove private access. Preserve draft/revision history; no secrets or raw session/media in audit logs.

remainingDecisionsAndAuthority: User completes the pending secure login handoff; independently prove actual source read afterward
Identify/review the existing bound Apps Script project and its intended trigger owner
Choose a supported unattended LMS authentication/session provider; do not extract browser cookies or invent an API
Approve exact top-row identity mapping, source field ownership and data destinations including private audit storage
Authorize actual trigger installation/OAuth expansion/deployment at the relevant setup step
If Apps Script cannot use a supported source provider, explicitly choose an alternate host and any cost/security changes

externalReferences.finding: nearMinute has plus/minus 15-minute timing; inTimezone explicitly selects the zone
Installable triggers run as the creator; each account cannot see triggers created by other accounts
New services/scopes can require explicit new authorization
Cloud Scheduler supports minute cron and explicit time zone
Cloud Run source deployment has API, build/storage and IAM requirements; it is not implied by existing Sheet bot access
